page.title: Position evaluation
page.lead: Aaron shows you a position: who is better? Five answers, from White's point of view: equal below {advantage} pawn, an advantage up to {winning} pawns, winning beyond that (a mate or a won endgame counts as winning). When the position has one, find the plan too (optional, as a bonus). Each run lasts 1, 2, 5 or 10 minutes: positions follow one another, take the time you need on each; the one on screen at the end does not count.
